$comment: Advisories we cannot fix yet, each with why and until when. Past `until`, the scan fails again and the entry must be re-checked. An entry that no advisory in any lockfile matches fails the scan too (a warning in the morning run): remove it once it stops applying.

accepted.why: Linux GTK stack pulled in by Tauri (webkit2gtk 4.1). Unsoundness in VariantStrIter, which we do not use. Goes away when Tauri moves to glib 0.20.
Unmaintained, build-time only (via Tauri's GTK bindings).
Unmaintained proc-macro, build-time only, via iroh -> netwatch -> netlink-packet-core. No known vulnerability.

Unmaintained, not vulnerable: its pin_mut! macro is in std (core::pin::pin!). Comes in only through hyper 1.x (via reqwest/hyper-rustls under iroh, iroh-relay, pkarr and tauri-plugin-updater, and hyper-util). Goes away when hyper drops it.

Unmaintained, not vulnerable: merged into zbus 6.0.0 (2026-10-16). Linux D-Bus only, via zbus 5 in apps/desktop and in notify-rust, tauri-plugin-notification and tauri-plugin-single-instance, whose latest releases still require zbus 5. Move to zbus 6 when they do.
